text:
Rae (docs): Pushed a focused PR to tighten Optimize docs: small batching defaults section, a KV-prefetch example, and a short note about quant profiles for very short prompts. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/633 — would love a quick review.

Diego (eng): Thanks. Quick scan: the Go example still calls NewGenCall(). Please switch to the request-builder pattern. I'll paste the corrected snippet here.

Rae (docs): Please paste it so we don't have to trigger another commit.

Diego (eng): ```go
// builder-style request (recommended)
req := client.NewRequest().WithModel("redwood/opt-1").WithBatching(true)
resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, req)
```

Liam W.: Noted. Also saw the embed examples using embed_model param. New SDK uses model="redwood/embed-1". I'll update the JS/Python snippets in the PR.

Hannah (perf): From perf testing: interactive UIs see best tail latency with batching window ~20-30ms. Batch/throughput jobs are fine at 100-200ms. Worth adding a short "defaults" bullet calling those out.

Rae (docs): Adding bullets: interactive: 20-30ms; high-throughput: 80-200ms. Keeping wording neutral.

Liam W.: Heads-up: two broken anchors in preview — the qprofiles short-seq anchor changed and the prefetch cheatsheet moved. I'll push a tiny redirect for qprofiles and change the prefetch link to a relative path.

CI-bot: preview build started: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.org/633. Link check: 2 broken links -> /internal/prefetch-cheatsheet, qprofiles#short-sequence.

Diego (eng): For the qprofile blurb, recommend: prefer fp16 for sequences <64 tokens; only enable 4-bit after regression/eval confirms parity. Maybe include a minimal qprofile JSON to be concrete.

Rae (docs): Draft qprofile inline: ```json
{"name":"shortseq-reco","dtype":"fp16","notes":"prefer fp16 for sequences <64 tokens; enable 4-bit only after regression tests"}
```

Liam W.: Redirect pushed for qprofiles anchor and prefetch link updated to ./prefetch/cheatsheet.md#examples. Re-running link check.

CI-bot: Re-run link check: 0 broken links. Build status: green. Lint: minor warning about an extra trailing space in batching.md (non-blocking).

Rae (docs): Fixed the trailing space. Also added a one-block YAML example showing a fallback routing policy for when batching breaches SLOs — short, illustrative only.

Diego (eng): Can you paste the YAML here so I can confirm it matches routing schema?

Rae (docs): ```yaml
routing:
  policy: prefer_low_latency
  fallback:
    - model: redwood/opt-1-lite
      reason: slo_violation
```

Hannah (perf): That looks fine. Also please add the microbenchmark note: throughput dip observed when batching window >50ms for interactive flows. One sentence suffices.

Rae (docs): Added the microbenchmark note and a short migration blurb: "Generate calls now use a request builder (client.Generate(ctx, req)); embed_model -> model; batching window moves to a duration type."

Liam W.: Leaving a small comment suggesting the migration blurb include a single-line code example for the new generate call.

Rae (docs): Added tiny code example in the migration note. CI re-run looks clean.

CI-bot: All checks passed. Link check: 0 errors. Build succeeded. Preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.org/633

Translation-bot: Note for localization: short-seq blurb needs translation in 3 locales (fr, de, ja). Adding an issue to i18n backlog.

Rae (docs): Thanks everyone. I'll merge once the changelog bullet is added (one-sentence summary). Can someone take that?

Diego (eng): I'll add the changelog line after merge: "Optimize: SDK migration example, batching defaults, KV-prefetch example, short-seq quant guidance."

Rae (docs): Perfect. Merging now. Closing thread. :tada:
